$comment: EV-7001 public DC fast charger twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the charger data sheet, the cable data sheet, the insulation monitoring practice of IEC 61851-23 and the uptime rule of the operator's funding programme; the charger, its cooling unit and the CSMS send only what they measure and count.

identification.model: hypercharger HYC400 (4 x 100 kW Power-Stacks, 400 kW, 2 x CCS2)
identification.description: Public DC fast charger, bay 1 of a motorway charging hub: two CCS2 outlets, liquid-cooled cables, card payment, OCPP to the CSMS
identification.site: Demo motorway charging hub, bays 1 and 2
identification.power: Four 100 kW Power-Stacks shared dynamically between the two outlets in 50 kW steps
identification.cable: Liquid-cooled CCS2 HPC cable, 5 m, 500 A permanent (for example Phoenix Contact CHARX connect professional 1494471)
identification.backend: OCPP 2.0.1 J to the operator's charging station management system (CSMS); payment terminal for cards; MID / calibration-law DC meter per outlet

charger.source: alpitronic HYC400 data sheet: 4 Power-Stacks of 100 kW, granularity 50 kW, 150-1000 V DC, CCS2 up to 600 A, efficiency up to 97.7 % at full load, up to 98.2 % peak, standby 43 W.

efficiency.source: Loss per active stack = a + c x P^2, fitted to the two published points (97.7 % at 100 kW per stack, 98.2 % peak). The shape (no-load loss + conduction loss) is an assumption: typical value, replace with the efficiency curve of the factory test report.

stack_thermal.source: Hottest heat sink rise over the cabinet air inlet per kW lost in one stack: assumption: typical value, replace with the commissioning trend at full power.

cable.source: Phoenix Contact CHARX connect professional 1494471 (5 m): 500 A permanent up to 40 C, 700 A boost, 150 A with a failed cooling unit, cooling capacity 900 W, flow 2 l/min, switch-off at 90 C at the DC contacts, 0.00078 ohm/m per power core at 20 C. Two power cores per pole (loop resistance 0.0039 ohm), the contact rise over the coolant (120 K per kA^2: 30 K at 500 A), and the density and specific heat of 50/50 glycol: assumption: typical value, replace with the cable maker's thermal data.

safety.source: Insulation monitoring of the DC output (IEC 61851-23 as commonly applied, IEC 61557-8 devices): warning below 500 ohm/V, fault below 100 ohm/V, referred to the 1000 V maximum output voltage (500 kohm and 100 kohm).

availability.source: US NEVI rule 23 CFR 680.116(b): each port > 97 % average annual uptime, mu = (525600 - (T_outage - T_excluded)) / 525600 x 100. UK Public Charge Point Regulations 2023: rapid network 99 % reliable on average (shown for comparison).

sessions.source: Charge-start success target of the operator: assumption: typical value, replace with your own service level. Counters are rolling 24 h values kept by the CSMS from the OCPP transaction events.

site.source: Hub conditions for the demo: assumption: typical value, replace with your site.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 10 times faster so a full session lasts about two minutes; the 24 h and 365 d counters come from the failure modes, not from the demo clock.

points.label: AC supply voltage, line to line
Outlet 1 hottest DC contact (NTC in the connector)
Outlet 2 hottest DC contact (NTC in the connector)
DC output insulation resistance, last check
Failed: insulation or contactor self-test, 24 h
Sessions stopped by the charger, 24 h
Outage minutes of the worse port, 365 d
Excluded outage minutes (grid, vandalism, planned), 365 d
Seconds since the last OCPP message to the CSMS
Last session energy, calibrated DC meter
Last session energy, charger's own measurement

twin_model.$limits_source: Alert limits: assumption: typical value, replace with your operator's service levels. 80 C is 10 K below the cable's 90 C switch-off; 1.4 l/min is 70 % of the cable's 2 l/min.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it (at full severity).

power_stack_failure.name: Power-Stack failure (output derated)
power_stack_failure.symptoms: one stack out of service: 300 kW left to share between the two outlets

stack_cooling_ageing.name: Power-Stack ageing or clogged air filter
stack_cooling_ageing.symptoms: losses above the efficiency curve, heat sinks hotter than the losses explain

coolant_flow_low.name: Cable cooling flow low (pump wear, blocked filter)
coolant_flow_low.symptoms: flow falls, coolant returns hotter, less margin before the cable must derate

contact_wear.name: Worn or dirty DC contacts, outlet 1
contact_wear.symptoms: contact temperature rises faster with current than the coolant explains

insulation_degradation.name: Insulation fault on the DC output (moisture in cable or connector)
insulation_degradation.symptoms: insulation resistance falls, the pre-charge check refuses to start

contactor_welded.name: Welded DC contactor, outlet 2
contactor_welded.symptoms: weld check fails, outlet 2 locked out, outage minutes grow

vehicle_comm_failures.name: Vehicle communication failures (control pilot / PLC modem)
vehicle_comm_failures.symptoms: charge starts fail during the ISO 15118 / DIN 70121 handshake

payment_backend_fault.name: Payment terminal or backend link fault
payment_backend_fault.symptoms: terminal offline, card payments rejected, OCPP messages late
